doc: ARC-06 registry of every Events signal. Param names are the achievements contract: the tracker maps emitted args to a dictionary by these names (ACH-03 where.param). wired=false means no emit site may exist yet; wired=true means one must exist under project/<emitter>/ and nowhere else outside tests/ and dev/.

signals.doc: Control passed from soul `from` to soul `to` (soul roster indices; ACH_SOUL_<n> matches to == n).
signals.name: soul_swapped

signals.doc: Rivet took a vehicle that was not its own.
signals.name: vehicle_hijacked

signals.contract: The full payload (killer, victim, kind) is decided BEFORE the damage chokepoint applies the lethal hit, and the chokepoint is the only emitter. Spike bug: evolve moves.gd:119 set death_kind after _damage(), so the kill log saw the default kind.
signals.doc: An actor died. Ids are runtime actor ids (the bubble sim slot or hero id), never data ids.
signals.name: actor_killed

signals.doc: The wanted level changed (ARC-08: emitted only by the one wanted setter).
signals.name: wanted_changed

signals.doc: Rivet's cash changed (ARC-08: emitted only by the one cash setter). amount is the new total; delta is signed.
signals.name: cash_changed

signals.doc: Rivet entered a vehicle (runtime vehicle id).
signals.name: vehicle_entered

signals.doc: Rivet left a vehicle (runtime vehicle id).
signals.name: vehicle_exited

signals.doc: A car Rivet drives hit a person (victim_id = the bubble sim slot): killed above the vehicle_handling kill_at speed, else knocked down. Combat's chokepoint turns a kill into actor_killed (kind run_over); the heat ladder may raise heat on it.
signals.name: pedestrian_struck

signals.doc: The next wave of a combat encounter began. encounter is the place id the encounter is held at (a quest location), wave counts from 1. Quest bark tag wave-start.
signals.name: wave_started

signals.doc: A boss stepped into the fight (boss is its character data id). Quest bark tag boss-intro.
signals.name: boss_engaged

signals.doc: An attack aimed at Rivet began its tell (wind-up, charge whine); weapon is its data id. Quest bark tag robo-tazer-charge (weapon robo-tazer).
signals.name: attack_telegraphed

signals.doc: Rivet took a hit (Rivet only, never every actor: ARC-07); weapon is the data id of what hit him. Quest bark tag robo-tazer-hit (weapon robo-tazer).
signals.name: player_hit

signals.doc: The voices in Rivet's head spiked (madness). Quest bark tag static-whisper-burst. Until a madness system exists in features/characters, quest 1's stage raises it (hiding, the Robo-tazer hit, the fire, Kilohm's scan).
signals.name: whispers_spiked

signals.doc: A body knocked another down (features/bodies tackle matrix: a run into a lighter class). Ids are runtime actor ids (the bubble sim slot, or Rivet's id); defender_class is the bodies.json class; at is where the defender was hit, metres. Low frequency: one per knockdown. No heat rule reads it yet (a tackled cop is still a cop).
signals.name: actor_knocked_down
